_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗大型部队冲锋时会无视其所有的冲锋加成
desc.en: When bracing, this unit negates the charge bonus of any large attacker.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队可以对冲锋而来的敌军造成额外伤害
desc.en: When bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阴
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yin unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity.
